executiveSummary: The Authority remains operationally ready for the 2026 hurricane season, with no identified threats to overall system integrity. Routine inspections, maintenance, and storm-readiness activities remain underway across the system. Q2 field inspections have been completed and are under Engineering review, and all PCCP stations remain operational and mission ready.
maintenanceActivities: Hurricane and River Floodgate Inspections 100% completed; no action needed until October 2026.
Seasonal storm readiness measures underway, including sandbag staging and facility preparation; crews completed filling 63 of the 100 3,000-lb bags for EJ.
Installed a new levee access gate by Floodgate M-01.
Crews covered multiple locations of graffiti around the system.
East Jefferson – Repaired rutting at the toe of the levee between S Cumberland St and Wilker Neal Ave; jersey barriers placed at end of both streets to mitigate future damage.
Lake Borgne – LPV148 (D route) earthen levee repairs continue.
Q1 valve exercises 100% completed on 3/9/2026; Q2 valve exercises 100% completed on 6/1/2026.
Critical facilities, generators, and support infrastructure remain operational; tornado caused wall collapse at Franklin Facility — area secured, awaiting approval to remove undamaged equipment.
Levee turf maintenance: crews worked significant overtime during late June and early July to maintain mowing schedules despite prolonged rainfall.

projects.name: Foreshore Erosion Repair
projects.status: USACE determined revised path forward requiring Board action; scheduled to advertise in July with Bid Opening August 21, 2026. Mitigation measures being scheduled at two eroded locations.

projects.name: West Return Wall Splash Pad
projects.status: Construction is substantially complete. Project in closeout phase.

projects.name: LPV Access Bridge
projects.status: Construction has begun. Contractor is mobilizing. RFI / shop drawings submittals underway.

projects.name: Orpheum Slope Paving
projects.status: Construction has begun. Contractor is mobilized and has begun clearing and grubbing. Staged concrete pours to commence in the next few weeks.

projects.name: Franklin Ave. Vault 4 – Final
projects.status: Bid opened May 26, 2026. Contract executed / recorded.

projects.name: London Avenue Canal Erosion Mitigation (Phase 1)
projects.status: 95% Plans and Specifications submitted. CEA negotiations ongoing regarding contractor canal access. Will be ready to advertise and award for construction to start at end of Hurricane Season.

projects.name: 40 Arpent Sheet Pile Rehabilitation (Phase 2)
projects.status: Design and Survey Task Orders have been executed.

projects.name: Franklin Herbicide Vehicle Containment
projects.status: Informal Bid Request yielded one bid above internal estimates. Design was revised. Readvertisement via Central Bidding planned.

projects.name: Lakeshore Drive Flooding Warning Signs
projects.status: Engineering reviewed, selected, and ordered warning sign systems. Currently exploring exact locations and coordinating design for installation with IDIQ holder.

projects.name: Tropical Storm Arthur – Franklin Facility Damage
projects.status: Engineering coordinating with Maintenance, Finance, Insurance Adjusters, and outside engineers for demolition and repair of the facility.

usace.note: With the exception of Bayou St John Sector Gate, all annual inspections completed with no findings impacting system readiness
